senses.gloss: बह् BAH, v. बंह् BAṂH.

बहिश्चर bahiś-cara, a. moving or appearing 🞄outside, external: w. prāṇa, m. sg. & pl. 🞄or hṛdaya, n. oneʼs external breath or heart, 🞄i. e. dear to one as oneʼs own life or heart;
 m. 🞄external spy.

बहिःशाला bahiḥ-śālā, f. outer hall;
 -śīta, 🞄a. cold outside, cool to the touch.
बहिष्टात् bahíṣ-ṭāt, ad. outside (V.).
बहिस्तपस् bahis-tapas, n. external asceticism.
बहिःसंस्थ bahiḥ-saṃstha, a. lying or situated 🞄outside (the town).
बहुरमध्य bahura-madhya, a. thick in the 🞄middle (Soma).
बाहुल bāhula, m. N.: -ka, n. multiplicity: 🞄ab. owing to the various applicability (of a 🞄rule).
बहुलित bahul-ita, pp. increased.

बहुलेतरपक्ष bahula‿itara-pakṣa, m. du. 🞄the dark and the (opposite =) light half of 🞄a month;
 -oṣadhika, a. having abundant 🞄herbs, overgrown with herbs.

बह्वोद bahv-oda, m. [for bahu‿uda, cp. bahūdaka] 🞄kind of ascetic regarding knowledge 🞄(as opposed to works) as the chief thing;
 🞄-auṣadhi-ka, a. [for -oṣa-] abounding in 🞄herbs.
बाहव bāháv-a, m. arm (V.).
बाहवि bā́hav-i, m. pat. (fr. bāhu) N. of a 🞄teacher.
बाहुगुण्य bāhu-guṇ-ya, n. possession of many 🞄excellence.
बाहुलता bāhu-latā, f. creeper-like arms: 🞄-antara, n. interval between the arms, chest, 🞄breast-bone.
बाहुश्रुत्य bāhu-śrutya, n. learning.

बाहूत्क्षेपम् bāhu‿utkṣepam, abs. throwing 🞄or tossing up the arms;
 -upapīḍam, abs. 🞄tossing with the arms.
बाहूबाहवि bāhū-bāhav-i, ad. hand to hand, 🞄in close encounter.
बाह्वृच्य bāhvṛc-ya, n. traditional teaching 🞄of the Bahvṛcas, the Ṛg-veda.

बाह्वोजस् bāhú‿ojas, n. strength of arm;
 a. 🞄strong in the arm.
